## Target subsystem

- [ ] JACK CLI (`bin/jack` — SSH / Tailscale device registry & diagnostics)
- [ ] JACK Desktop & Easy Pairing (`desktop/` + `easy-pairing/`)
- [ ] Documentation / CI / Tooling

## User problem

Who encounters this problem, and what workflow are they trying to accomplish?

## Proposed outcome

What specific behavior or UX change would solve the problem? Include relevant platform and least-privilege constraints.

## Alternatives considered

> **Security Reminder**: Do not include credentials, private keys, tokens, or unredacted tailnet data. Report suspected security vulnerabilities privately via [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/mmontielpz/jack/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
